name: com.jclewis/connectagent
title: J.C. Lewis Auto Group
description: Search J.C. Lewis inventory, pricing, Ford incentives, KBB trade-ins, quotes, and service booking.

tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Search JCL vehicle inventory with full pricing. ALWAYS searches ALL J.C. Lewis stores (Savannah, Pooler, Hinesville, Statesboro, Lincoln) — J.C. Lewis cross-sells between locations, so a vehicle at another store is still available to the customer. The `store` argument is only a PREFERENCE that shows that store's vehicles first; it never hides the other stores. Accepts a stock number (e.g. 'F6094'), VIN, or model name (e.g. 'F-150', 'Explorer'). Make prefixes are stripped automatically — 'Ford F-150' and 'F-150' both work, as do common variants like 'F150'. Condition accepts NEW, USED, or CPO/CERTIFIED to filter certified pre-owned vehicles. Optional filters: min_year, max_year, min_price, max_price. Optional sort: 'discount_desc' ranks ALL matches by biggest dealer discount off MSRP (MSRP minus dealer_discounted_price) before applying the limit — use this when the customer asks for the best deal or biggest savings. Every result also includes discount_off_msrp (dollar amount) and discount_pct (percentage off MSRP). Returns MSRP, sale price, incentives, rebates, dealer fee, and the store each vehicle is at. The `total` field is the REAL number of matches across all stores (may exceed `returned`); `returned` is how many are in this response. Always tell the customer which location a vehicle is at, and NEVER tell them a J.C. Lewis location does not exist.

tools.name: get_vehicle_by_vin
tools.description: Get full vehicle details by VIN including pricing, incentives, features, and photos.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check availability and pricing for multiple VINs (up to 50).

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List all JCL store locations with codes (SAV, POO, HIN, STA, LIN).

tools.name: get_vehicle_rebates
tools.description: Get rebates and incentives for a vehicle by VIN. Returns MSRP, sale price, total incentives, and list of specific rebates (e.g., 'Model Year Closeout Bonus Cash'). Searches across all JCL stores.

tools.name: search_vehicles_with_rebates
tools.description: Search for vehicles with active rebates/incentives across ALL J.C. Lewis stores. Filter by model (e.g. 'F-150', 'Expedition') and condition (NEW/USED). The `store` argument is only a PREFERENCE that surfaces that store first — results always span the whole group because J.C. Lewis cross-sells. Returns pricing breakdown, incentive details, and the store each vehicle is at.

tools.name: get_vehicle_facts
tools.description: Get the complete picture for one vehicle by VIN: live asking price, MSRP, savings off MSRP, dealer fee, incentives, and specs. This is the preferred single call for a vehicle detail page.

tools.name: quote_out_the_door
tools.description: Calculate a full itemized out-the-door price for a vehicle by VIN. ALWAYS ask the customer what state they will register the vehicle in and pass it as buyer_state (two-letter code) — tax depends entirely on where they title, not where the car sits. Georgia buyers get TAVT (7% of fair market value), title, and tag. Out-of-state buyers get a quote that EXCLUDES tax, title, and registration, because Georgia TAVT is not owed when the vehicle is titled elsewhere and J.C. Lewis does not calculate other states' tax here — tell those customers the total excludes their home-state tax and is not the final out-the-door cost. Optionally accepts a trade allowance (which reduces the taxable base under Georgia law), trade payoff, and down payment. The response includes a 'binding' flag — when true every figure is confirmed from live data; when false, treat it as an estimate and say so. Never present a figure this tool did not calculate, and never invent a tax rate for another state.

tools.name: decode_trade_in_vin
tools.description: Decode a trade-in vehicle VIN. Returns year, make, model, trim, engine, transmission, drivetrain, available colors, typical mileage, and eligibility.

tools.name: get_condition_questions
tools.description: Get the condition assessment questions for a trade-in vehicle. Returns the history questions (original owner, accidents, odors, keys, etc.) and condition tiers (Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair) that must be answered to determine trade-in value.

tools.name: get_trade_in_value
tools.description: Get trade-in value for a vehicle. Requires VIN, mileage, condition tier (excellent/very_good/good/fair), and answers to history questions: original_owner, accidents ('Yes'/'No'/'Not Sure'), insurance_claims, odors, service_records, multiple_keys, rental_car, making_payments. IMPORTANT: this tool CANNOT produce a dollar amount — KBB gates offer generation on our key, so it returns a condition assessment only (tier placement, mileage comparison, history impact). Use it to pre-qualify the vehicle conversationally, then call get_trade_in_link to send the customer to KBB for their actual Instant Cash Offer. Never invent, estimate, or imply a trade-in dollar figure, and do not tell the customer 'the sales team will finalize the value' as if a number already exists — it does not.

tools.name: get_trade_in_offer
tools.description: Read a trade-in offer by offer ID. Returns full valuation breakdown: trade-in values by condition tier (Excellent/Very Good/Good/Fair with low/mid/high ranges), wholesale value, mileage adjustment, color adjustment, condition adjustment, key factors, and weekly depreciation.

tools.name: get_trade_in_link
tools.description: Get the KBB Instant Cash Offer link for a store — this is how a customer gets a REAL dollar amount for their trade. Use this whenever someone asks what their vehicle is worth, or after get_trade_in_value returns a condition assessment without a price. Pass the store the customer is working with (SAV/STA/HIN/POO/MAZ, or a city name); Lincoln routes to Statesboro. The customer completes KBB's own flow and receives a redeemable Instant Cash Offer certificate. IMPORTANT: never quote or guess a trade-in dollar amount yourself — we cannot generate one. Hand them the link and be straightforward that KBB is where the number comes from.

tools.name: get_towing_capacity
tools.description: Look up towing capacity for a Ford F-Series truck by VIN. Decodes the VIN via NHTSA to identify the model, engine, cab type, and drive type, then returns the towing capacity RANGE based on Ford's official towing guides. The exact capacity within the range depends on axle ratio, tow packages, and other configuration — those details are not encoded in the VIN. A link to Ford's official towing calculator is included for the customer to get their exact number. Currently supports F-150, F-250, F-350, and F-450 (2020–2027 model years).

tools.name: schedule_service
tools.description: Use this whenever the customer asks about SERVICE, maintenance, repairs, oil changes, tires, brakes, batteries, recalls, warranty work, a check-engine light, or booking a service appointment. Returns the official J.C. Lewis scheduling link (per-store when `store` is given, otherwise the group scheduler that lists every location), plus the service address and phone. Pass mobile=true if the customer wants a technician to come to their home or office (Ford Mobile Service). NEVER quote service hours, wait times, repair prices, or specific appointment availability — only the scheduler knows real availability. Hand the customer the link.

tools.name: get_ford_offers
tools.description: Look up Ford's FINANCING offers for a VIN — promotional APR programs and lease programs — plus Ford's own view of cash incentives. Use this when the customer asks about financing, monthly payments, APR, leasing, or 'what's the best deal', and BEFORE building a proposal for a new Ford: many units qualify for promotional rates far below standard financing (0.9% has been seen on F-150s), which get_vehicle_rebates does not carry. Requires the customer's full name and home address — Ford will not return offers without them, so ask the customer first (e.g. 'Want me to check for additional Ford incentives and special financing? I'll need your name and address'). CRITICAL: promotional APR and cash are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE — taking a low rate means taking less cash; present them as a choice, never added together. Quote an APR only with its credit tier and term band. Programs listed as conditional require the customer to qualify (trade-in, brand loyalty, proof of ownership) — mention them as possible additional savings, never as guaranteed. If the tool reports found=false, use get_vehicle_rebates and do NOT tell the customer there are no offers.

tools.name: build_proposal
tools.description: Build a priced deal proposal for a specific vehicle and customer. Returns the full proposal payload for the widget to render: vehicle details with photo, deal breakdown (selling price, Georgia TAVT, fees, final price), and a finance grid of monthly payments across terms and down payments. Pricing starts from our published internet price. If the customer says the price is too high, call again with negotiation_round=2 for our best offer (2% off) — there is NO third round; if they still decline, call submit_deal_handoff so a salesperson can work the deal. ALWAYS ask what state the customer will register the vehicle in and pass buyer_state (two-letter code): Georgia buyers get Georgia TAVT, title, and tag, while out-of-state buyers get a proposal that EXCLUDES tax, title, and registration (owed in their home state and not calculated here) — say so plainly and never invent another state's tax rate. Payments are ESTIMATES based on market-average rates for the given credit tier, not approvals — always present them that way and never promise a rate or approval. Optional: terms (default 48/60/72), down_payments (default 0/1000/2000), credit_tier (750+, 700-749, 650-699, 600-649).

tools.name: submit_deal_handoff
tools.description: Submit the customer as a lead to the dealership's CRM. Sends a structured ADF lead with customer info, vehicle, pricing, trade-in, and finance preferences so the sales team can follow up. REQUIRES customer phone or email — the agent MUST collect contact info before calling this. Pass vehicle_store (SAV/POO/HIN/STA/LIN/MAZ) so the lead reaches the right store; if that store has no CRM intake configured the call returns an error and NOTHING is sent, so tell the customer to call the dealership directly. This is the final step in the deal flow.

tools.name: check_ford_private_offers
tools.description: Check whether a specific customer has Ford PRIVATE offers on a VIN — targeted incentives Ford assigns to individuals (owner loyalty, conquest, lease maturity, mailer certificates). Ford requires the customer's FULL identity: first name, last name, street address, city, state, and ZIP — collect all of these from the customer before calling; never guess or reuse another person's identity. Most shoppers have no private offer; an empty result is normal and public rebates (get_vehicle_rebates) may still apply. Only one private offer certificate can be applied per deal.
